endeavor.title: Der Turm im Nebelmoor
endeavor.description: Two years after the Test-Endeavor, Test-Member and Jörn Eisenfaust follow a rumour of a drowned tower into the [[Moor|Nebelmoor]]. Their guide is Mirela vom Mühlbach, who knows the paths & the price of losing them. A second paragraph, so that line breaks inside a description are covered as well.

event.title: Ein Führer mit Preis
event.description: In the mill at Mühlbach, Mirela vom Mühlbach names her price: "half of whatever the tower gives up". Jörn Eisenfaust haggles, Test-Member pays.

event.title: Lichter über dem Wasser
event.description: On the first of the nameless days the Moorlicht lead the heroes off the path. Jörn Eisenfaust recognises them as [[Irrlicht|will-o'-the-wisps]] just in time.

event.title: Rückweg ohne Karte
event.description: An event without a location, as the data allows.
